scope: Model layer integrity, BranchScope coverage gaps, FK soundness, inheritance/trait cleanliness
approach: Read-only static analysis. Compared the 22 BranchScope-applied models against the 32 models with branch_id columns (or pseudo-tenant ownership). Inspected core relations, inheritance, and identified scope-gap classes.

findings.title: 10 models carry branch_id but DO NOT apply BranchScope — divergence from CLAUDE.md §9 inventory of 17 (advertises 11, actually 22 applied)

models.note: Auto-populates branch_id in booted() but never registers BranchScope global. DashboardService::auditTrail must manually filter.
INTENTIONAL — fiscal append-only, scope would interfere with HMAC chain rebuild + admin verification. KEEP-AS-IS.
INTENTIONAL — fiscal table, admin/owner cross-branch view required for Z verify/archive. KEEP-AS-IS.
Extends User (single-table inheritance on users) — relies on User exemption + caller-side filter. Risk: NFC UID lookup cross-branch leak if controller forgets where('branch_id', ...).
Outbox for async dispatch. branch_id stored for routing. Workers run console so BranchScope wouldn't apply anyway. KEEP-AS-IS.
POS-9.1.4 dining audit trail. Same family as ActionLog — admin-only inspection. Should be scoped at controller layer.
Legacy admin messaging. Low usage — 0 controller hits in fast-path. Acceptable gap.
Mirrors DiningTable (which DOES apply BranchScope). Reuses same `dining_tables` table — risk: same table, two models with divergent scoping.
branch_id required-where in scopeValidFor() at usage site. Per-call filter, not global. Acceptable but documented.
Same pattern as KioskPromo — scopeActiveForBranch(). Per-call. Acceptable.

findings.removes_breaks: ADD-ONLY recommendation — adding scope to AuditLog/ZReport WOULD BREAK fiscal verify (cross-branch admin must see all). Customer/FrontendDiningTable add WOULD NEED testing as those models may be queried pre-auth (Sanctum login flow).
findings.decision: Keep current state. Document the intentional exemptions in model class docblocks (already partially done).

findings.title: FrontendDiningTable and DiningTable both target `dining_tables` — single-table inheritance without scope parity
findings.evidence: app/Models/FrontendDiningTable.php:12 `protected $table = "dining_tables";` — but no BranchScope. app/Models/DiningTable.php applies BranchScope. Two models, one table, divergent isolation.
findings.removes_breaks: Removing FrontendDiningTable would require migrating callers to DiningTable. Risk: pre-auth kiosk lookups may rely on global view. KEEP-AS-IS, document.

findings.title: 23 models lack HasFactory trait — partial test infrastructure coverage
findings.removes_breaks: No — adding HasFactory is non-destructive. Removing trait absences increases test ergonomics.
findings.decision: STRUCTURAL-RECOMMENDATION — add HasFactory to fiscal/operational models for future test coverage. Not urgent.

findings.title: Customer extends User (single-table inheritance) — same `users` table with role-based filtering
findings.evidence: app/Models/Customer.php:9 `class Customer extends User` — comment 'In-app customer accounts live in users with the Customer role'. Adds nfc_uid + is_guest fillable.
findings.removes_breaks: Removing Customer would require renaming queries throughout. KEEP-AS-IS, document inheritance choice.
findings.decision: STRUCTURAL-OK — pattern is intentional and documented in class docblock.

findings.title: WizardProfileBranchScope is sister to BranchScope — handles nullable branch_id_scope semantics (global OR scoped)
findings.removes_breaks: Removing or merging would break wizard profile inheritance. KEEP-AS-IS — well-justified by 2026-05-18 PR-D blocker heal comment.

findings.title: BranchScope skips authenticated checks in console mode unless runningUnitTests() — workers/cron see ALL branches
findings.implication: Cron/queue workers (fiscal verify, Z report cron, outbox dispatch) intentionally see all branches. This is correct for cross-branch system tasks (e.g., FiscalVerifyChainCommand). Document but do not change — frozen file.
findings.decision: DOCUMENT — confirm callers always wrap with `withoutGlobalScope(BranchScope::class)` when needed and never rely on implicit console-bypass behavior in HTTP path.

summary.verdict: Architecture is sound. BranchScope coverage is broader than CLAUDE.md §9 claims (22 vs 11 advertised — drift in DOCUMENTATION, not code). 3 borderline models need controller-layer audit but no code change to fix.
